items.title: 10.17.2 E standard qeematon se reaction ki feasibility (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 10.17.2 with Figures 10.9 and 10.10 and Quick Check 10.8, printed pages 231-233.

blocks.text: Standard electrode potential (E°) values batati hain ke kisi species ko oxidize ya reduce karna kitna aasan ya mushkil hai. E° values ko barhti hui negative tarteeb (zyada positive se zyada negative) mein likha jata hai. Har half-equation mein zyada oxidized shakal baen (left) aur zyada reduced shakal daen (right) hoti hai.

items: E° jitna zyada positive, half-equation ke aage (forward) chalne ka rujhan utna zyada, aur baen taraf ki species ko reduce karna utna aasan.
E° jitna kam positive, half-equation ke ulta (reverse) chalne ka rujhan utna zyada, aur daen taraf ki species ko oxidize karna utna aasan.

blocks.text: Mg²⁺ aur Ag ke darmiyan reaction mumkin hai ya nahi, yeh dekhne ke liye:
Half-cell equations aur E° values chahiye:
Yahan Mg²⁺ ko reduce aur Ag ko oxidize hona hai, to:
E°cell negative hai, is liye yeh reaction mumkin (feasible) nahi. Is ke ulat Ag⁺ aur Mg ka reaction mumkin hai, kyun ke us ka E°cell positive hai:

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ne Mg²⁺ + Ag ke liye (−2.32) − (+0.80) = −1.52 V aur Ag⁺ + Mg ke liye (−0.80) − (−2.32) = +1.52 V chhapa hai. Dono hisab ghalat hain: −2.32 − 0.80 = −3.12 V, aur silver ka E° +0.80 V hai (−0.80 nahi), is liye +0.80 − (−2.32) = +3.12 V. Nateeja wahi hai: Mg²⁺ + Ag mumkin nahi, Ag⁺ + Mg mumkin hai. (Magnesium ki value kitab yahan −2.32 V, Figure 10.9 mein −2.38 V aur Table 10.2 mein −2.37 V deti hai; maqbool value taqreeban −2.37 V hai.)

blocks.alt: Chhe half-equations tarteeb se: Cl2 + 2e- se 2Cl-(aq), +1.36 V; Ag+(aq) + e- se Ag(s), +0.80 V; Cu2+(aq) + 2e- se Cu(s), +0.34 V; H+(aq) + e- se 1/2 H2(g), +0.00 V; Zn2+(aq) + 2e- se Zn(s), -0.76 V; Mg2+(aq) + 2e- se Mg(s), -2.38 V. Baen taraf oopar ka teer (baen species ki oxidizing taaqat aur electrons lene ka rujhan barhta hai) 'Strongest Oxidizing agent' tak; daen taraf neeche ka teer (daen species ki reducing taaqat aur electrons dene ka rujhan barhta hai) 'Strongest Reducing agent' tak.
blocks.caption: Figure 10.9: Kuch oxidizing aur reducing agents ke standard electrode potentials (kitab ki Figure 10.9 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Is list mein jo species jitna oopar baen taraf hai, woh utni aasani se electrons leti hai (taqatwar oxidizing agent; sab se taqatwar Cl₂). Jo jitna neeche daen taraf hai, woh utni aasani se electrons deti hai (taqatwar reducing agent; sab se taqatwar Mg). Is liye Ag⁺ aur Mg ka reaction hota hai magar Mg²⁺ aur Ag ka nahi.
Cu²⁺/Cu aur Zn²⁺/Zn ke cell mein zinc ka electrons khone ka rujhan copper se zyada hai, is liye zinc wale half-cell mein reaction ulti simt mein chalta hai:
Dono half-equations ko jor kar poore cell ka reaction milta hai:
Yahi reaction electrochemical cell mein hota hai. Zinc metal aur copper ions ka reaction mumkin hai. Agar aage ka reaction mumkin ho to ulta reaction (copper metal aur zinc ions) mumkin nahi hota.

Agar copper ka tukra seedha 1.00 mol dm⁻³ Zn²⁺ solution mein dala jaye to koi reaction nahi hota. Half-equations ko oopar neeche likhein to reaction ki simt oopar baen se shuru ho kar clockwise (ghari ki suiyon ki simt) pattern se milti hai: reactant, product, reactant, product — jaisa Figure 10.10 mein Cu²⁺/Cu aur Zn²⁺/Zn ke liye dikhaya gaya hai.

blocks.alt: E standard / V ka teer oopar ki taraf, oopar wali lakeer ke paas +0.34 aur neeche wali ke paas -0.76. Dabbe mein: Cu2+ + 2e- aur Cu ka equilibrium, Cu2+ par 'Better oxidant (Reactant)' aur Cu par '(Product)'; neeche Zn2+ + 2e- aur Zn ka equilibrium, Zn2+ par '(Product)' aur Zn par 'Better reductant (Reactant)'. Ek ghumaodar teer oopar se Cu2+ se Cu tak aur doosra neeche se Zn se Zn2+ tak: ghari ki suiyon ki simt (clockwise).
blocks.caption: Figure 10.10: Reaction us simt hota hai jis mein taqatwar oxidizing agent taqatwar reducing agent se react kare (kitab ki Figure 10.10 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Clockwise rule: oopar wali (zyada positive) half-equation aage chalti hai (Cu²⁺ → Cu) aur neeche wali ulti chalti hai (Zn → Zn²⁺). Yani taqatwar oxidizing agent (Cu²⁺) taqatwar reducing agent (Zn) se react karta hai.

blocks.prompt: a) E° Cl₂/2Cl⁻ = +1.36 V, Br₂/2Br⁻ = +1.07 V, I₂/2I⁻ = +0.54 V ki madad se: i) iodide ions bromine se oxidize ho sakte hain; ii) bromine chloride ions se react kyun nahi karti?
blocks.explanation: i) Br₂/Br⁻ (+1.07 V) I₂/I⁻ (+0.54 V) se zyada positive hai, is liye Br₂ oxidizing agent ban kar I⁻ ko I₂ mein oxidize karti hai: Br₂ + 2I⁻ → 2Br⁻ + I₂, E°cell = 1.07 − 0.54 = +0.53 V. ii) Br₂ + 2Cl⁻ ke liye E°cell = 1.07 − 1.36 = −0.29 V (negative), is liye reaction nahi hota.

items: Zyada positive E°: baen species aasani se reduce; zyada negative E°: daen species aasani se oxidize.
E°cell = E°red − E°ox; positive ho to reaction mumkin: Ag⁺ + Mg haan, Mg²⁺ + Ag nahi; Zn + Cu²⁺ haan, Cu + Zn²⁺ nahi.
Clockwise rule (Figure 10.10): taqatwar oxidizing agent taqatwar reducing agent se react karta hai.
